records.title: Model Reduction for Nonlinear Systems by Balanced Truncation of State and Gradient Covariance
records.model: nonlinear dynamical systems; toy system and axisymmetric jet
records.observed_mechanism: State and output-gradient covariances define an oblique projection balancing variability and sensitivity; snapshot cross-covariance SVD yields dual projection bases.
records.physical_action: Offline state/adjoint-gradient snapshot sampling, cross-covariance SVD and reduced model construction; no native Wan operator executed.
records.decision_time: Offline after sampling trajectory states and adjoint responses, before reduced model deployment.
records.training: Regression is used for learned nonlinear feature models; Petrov-Galerkin is a separate option.
records.wan_specific_discriminator: Bound assumes conditional Gaussian conditions and particular marginal covariances; averaged state/gradient covariance is not an exact same-source gate-conditioned joint suffix objective. Test paired versus shuffled responses and native finite perturbations.

method_details.equations: Theorem 3: for Wx=XX^T, Wg=YY^T, Y^T X=UΣV^T, Φ=XV_rΣ_r^-1/2, Ψ=YU_rΣ_r^-1/2, P=ΦΨ^T; Gaussian-conditional result bounds expectation by C tr(Wg(I-P)Wx(I-P)^T).
method_details.sampling: Uses independent zero-mean isotropic output probes to sample projected gradients; state and gradient snapshots provide covariance factors.
method_details.limit: The bound is not a generic theorem for discrete BF16/QDQ Wan or source-coupled costs.

records.title: 2ndMatch: Finetuning Pruned Diffusion Models via Second-Order Jacobian Matching
records.model: pruned image diffusion U-Nets and diffusion transformers
records.observed_mechanism: Randomly projected stepwise J^T J metric matching aligns teacher/student local perturbation sensitivity during diffusion-model finetuning.
records.physical_action: Train a pruned student with noise prediction, teacher output distillation and projected Jacobian-metric matching; teacher and derivative work are paid offline.
records.decision_time: During post-pruning finetuning on noisy inputs and selected diffusion timesteps.
records.training: Yes: finetuning with dense teacher and Jacobian-related gradients.
records.wan_specific_discriminator: J^T J is a second-order metric, not a Hessian; stepwise metric matching is not an exact multi-step suffix Jacobian, and the image-diffusion evidence does not establish four-step Wan video or HiF4 behavior.

method_details.objective: Combines noise-prediction loss, teacher-output knowledge distillation and second-order Jacobian-metric matching.
method_details.sampling: Uses random projections to estimate v^T J^T J v at individual steps instead of tracking a full multi-step Jacobian.
method_details.limit: Does not establish target-specific motion sensitivity, output direction sign, or full-suffix causal fidelity.

records.title: Importance-Aware Low-Rank Distillation of Diffusion Transformers
records.model: FLUX.dev image diffusion transformer and temporally distilled image model
records.observed_mechanism: Individually compress each transformer block, rank by generated-set CMMD, allocate projection SVD ranks under a global budget and optionally recover with modular distillation plus rectified-flow training.
records.physical_action: Offline probe generated images, construct truncated-SVD projection factors, allocate block ranks and finetune; compare training-free and trained models.
records.decision_time: Offline block probing and rank allocation before optional recovery finetuning and inference.
records.training: Main method uses modular teacher distillation plus rectified-flow finetuning; a separate training-free SVD evaluation is reported.
records.wan_specific_discriminator: CMMD ranks image-distribution degradation after one-block compression, not a paired local gate-conditioned sensitivity matrix; image-model parameter savings do not establish HiF4 FFN full-video latency or quality.

method_details.probing: Compress one block at a time with matched prompts/seeds; use set-level CMMD for rank ordering, not just per-sample LPIPS.
method_details.compression: Allocate nonuniform block budgets then truncate projection matrices; apply modular teacher distillation and rectified-flow objective for trained method.
method_details.limit: Reported paper is image generation and parameter budget; no measured Wan I2V full-system result.
